mapper.sql: a.sch01_info_id AS info_id, a.sch01_company_id AS company_id, a.sch01_title AS title, a.sch01_content AS content, a.sch01_report AS report, a.sch01_manager_id AS manager_id, a.sch01_note AS note, a.sch01_use_yn AS use_yn, a.sch01_dcr_class_tree_id AS dcr_class_tree_id, a.sch01_private_yn AS private_yn, a.sch01_daily_yn AS daily_yn, a.sch01_class_id AS class_id, f_emp_kor_nm(a.sch01_manager_id) AS manager_name, f_class_tree_nm_allpath(sch01_dcr_class_tree_id) AS dcr_class_tree_name, ( SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=1 THEN MIN(f_cdnm('CycleCode', sch03_cycle_cd, sch03_company_id, f_sysdate())) ELSE MIN(f_cdnm('CycleCode', sch03_cycle_cd, sch03_company_id, f_sysdate()))||' 외 '||COUNT(sch03_deadline.*)-1||'건' END FROM sch03_deadline WHERE sch03_schedule_cd = '1' AND sch03_info_id = sch01_info_id AND f_today() BETWEEN COALESCE(sch03_start_date,'2000-01-01') AND COALESCE(sch03_close_date,'9999-12-31') LIMIT 1 ) AS deadline_name, ( SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=1 THEN MIN(f_get_deadline_nm(sch03_deadline_id, '1')) ELSE MIN(f_get_deadline_nm(sch03_deadline_id, '1'))||' 외 '||COUNT(sch03_deadline.*)-1||'건' END FROM sch03_deadline WHERE sch03_info_id = sch01_info_id AND sch03_schedule_cd = '1' AND f_today() BETWEEN COALESCE(sch03_start_date,'2000-01-01') AND COALESCE(sch03_close_date,'9999-12-31') ) AS deadline_full_name, ( SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=1 THEN MIN(f_org_nm(sch02_org_id, f_sysdate())) ELSE MIN(f_org_nm(sch02_org_id, f_sysdate())) || ' 외 ' || COUNT(sch02_share.*) - 1 END FROM sch02_share WHERE sch01_info_id = sch02_info_id AND sch02_share_cd = '2' LIMIT 1 ) AS share_org_name, ( SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=1 THEN MIN(f_emp_kor_nm(sch02_person_id)) ELSE MIN(f_emp_kor_nm(sch02_person_id))||' 외 '||COUNT(sch02_share.*)-1 END FROM sch02_share WHERE sch01_info_id = sch02_info_id AND sch02_share_cd = '1' LIMIT 1 ) AS share_person_name, ( SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=1 THEN MAX(f_ics_class_tree_nm(sch05_ics_class_tree_id)) ELSE MAX(f_ics_class_tree_nm(sch05_ics_class_tree_id))||' 외 '||COUNT(*)-1||'건' END FROM sch05_relate_ics WHERE sch05_info_id = sch01_info_id ) AS ics_class_tree_name, CASE WHEN COALESCE(sch01_private_yn,'false') = 'true' THEN '비공개' ELSE '' END AS private_yn_name, CASE WHEN COALESCE(sch01_daily_yn,'false') = 'true' THEN 'O' ELSE '' END AS daily_yn_name, ( SELECT MIN(f_get_alarm_info(sch06_alarm_id)) || CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN '' ELSE ' 외 '||COUNT(*)-1||'건' END FROM sch06_alarm WHERE sch06_company_id = sch01_company_id AND sch06_target_cd = 'SCH' AND sch06_target_id = sch01_info_id AND COALESCE(sch06_use_yn,'false') = 'true' ) AS alarm_info

SELECT sch10_ipo_id AS info_id , '[수요예측] '||sch10_item_nm AS title , CONCAT('시장구분 : ', f_cdnm('MarketCode', sch10_market_cd, sch10_company_id, f_today()) ,' / ' ,'희망공모가 : ',sch10_price_bracket ,E'
주간사 : ',sch10_note) AS content , sch10_demand_start_date AS close_date FROM sch10_ipo WHERE sch10_demand_start_date BETWEEN #{startDate}::date AND #{endDate}::date AND COALESCE(sch10_cancel_yn,'false') != 'true' UNION ALL SELECT sch10_ipo_id AS info_id , '[공모주청약] '||sch10_item_nm AS title , CONCAT('시장구분 : ',f_cdnm('MarketCode', sch10_market_cd, sch10_company_id, f_today()) ,' / ' ,'공모가 : ',COALESCE(TO_CHAR(sch10_price,'FM999,999,999'),'미정') ,E'
주간사 : ',sch10_note) AS content , sch10_subscription_start_date AS close_date FROM sch10_ipo WHERE sch10_subscription_start_date BETWEEN #{startDate}::date AND #{endDate}::date AND COALESCE(sch10_cancel_yn,'false') != 'true' UNION ALL SELECT sch10_ipo_id AS info_id , '[공모주납입] '||sch10_item_nm AS title , CONCAT('시장구분 : ',f_cdnm('MarketCode', sch10_market_cd, sch10_company_id, f_today()) ,' / ' ,'공모가 : ',COALESCE(TO_CHAR(sch10_price,'FM999,999,999'),'미정') ,E'
주간사 : ',sch10_note) AS content , sch10_pay_date AS close_date FROM sch10_ipo WHERE sch10_pay_date BETWEEN #{startDate}::date AND #{endDate}::date AND COALESCE(sch10_cancel_yn,'false') != 'true' UNION ALL SELECT sch10_ipo_id AS info_id , '[공모주상장] '||sch10_item_nm AS title , CONCAT('시장구분 : ',f_cdnm('MarketCode', sch10_market_cd, sch10_company_id, f_today()) ,' / ' ,'공모가 : ',COALESCE(TO_CHAR(sch10_price,'FM999,999,999'),'미정') ,E'
주간사 : ',sch10_note) AS content , sch10_list_date AS close_date FROM sch10_ipo WHERE sch10_list_date BETWEEN #{startDate}::date AND #{endDate}::date AND COALESCE(sch10_cancel_yn,'false') != 'true'
mapper.select: SELECT sch01_info_id AS info_id , sch08_class_nm AS class_name , sch01_title AS title , sch01_content AS content , sch01_report AS report , f_get_deadline_nm(sch03_deadline_id, '2') AS deadline_name , sch01_note AS note FROM sch01_info INNER JOIN sch03_deadline ON ( sch03_info_id = sch01_info_id AND sch03_deadline_id = #{deadlineId} ) LEFT OUTER JOIN sch08_class ON sch08_class_id = sch01_class_id WHERE sch01_info_id = #{infoId} AND sch01_company_id = #{companyId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sch04_list WHERE sch04_schedule_cd = '1' AND sch04_info_id = #{infoId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys05_user_role INNER JOIN sys04_role ON sys04_role_id = sys05_role_id AND sys04_company_id = #{companyId} AND sys04_admin_yn = 'true' WHERE sys05_user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sch01_info (sch01_info_id, sch01_company_id, sch01_manager_id, sch01_use_yn) VALUES (#{infoId}, #{companyId}, #{managerId}, 'true')
mapper.select: SELECT a.sch02_share_id AS share_id, a.sch02_info_id AS info_id, a.sch02_share_cd AS share_code, f_cdnm('ShareCode', sch02_share_cd, sch01_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS share_name, a.sch02_person_id AS person_id, f_emp_kor_nm(sch02_person_id) AS person_name, a.sch02_org_id AS org_id, f_org_nm(sch02_org_id, f_sysdate()) AS org_name, a.sch02_company_id AS company_id, a.sch02_start_date AS start_date, a.sch02_close_date AS close_date FROM sch02_share a INNER JOIN sch01_info b ON b.sch01_info_id = a.sch02_info_id INNER JOIN sys01_company c ON c.sys01_company_id = a.sch02_company_id WHERE sch02_info_id = #{infoId} AND sch02_company_id = #{companyId} ORDER BY sch02_share_cd, sch02_org_id

SELECT a.sch02_share_id AS share_id, a.sch02_info_id AS info_id, a.sch02_share_cd AS share_code, f_cdnm('ShareCode', sch02_share_cd, sch01_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS share_name, a.sch02_person_id AS person_id, f_emp_kor_nm(sch02_person_id) AS person_name, a.sch02_org_id AS org_id, f_org_nm(sch02_org_id, f_sysdate()) AS org_name, a.sch02_company_id AS company_id, a.sch02_start_date AS start_date, a.sch02_close_date AS close_date FROM sch02_share a INNER JOIN sch01_info b ON b.sch01_info_id = a.sch02_info_id WHERE sch02_share_id = #{shareId} AND sch02_company_id = #{companyId}

SELECT sch01_info_id AS info_id, sch01_company_id AS company_id, sch01_title AS title, sch01_content AS content, sch01_report AS report, sch01_manager_id AS manager_id, sch01_note AS note, sch01_use_yn AS use_yn, sch01_dcr_class_tree_id AS dcr_class_tree_id, sch01_private_yn AS private_yn, sch01_daily_yn AS daily_yn, sch01_class_id AS class_id, NULL AS class_name FROM sch01_info WHERE sch01_company_id = #{companyId} AND sch01_info_id IN #{infoId} ORDER BY COALESCE(sch01_class_id, 999999999999999)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sch02_share (sch02_share_id, sch02_info_id, sch02_company_id, sch02_share_cd, sch02_person_id, sch02_org_id, sch02_start_date, sch02_close_date) SELECT f_create_seq(), #{newInfoId}, sch02_company_id, sch02_share_cd, sch02_person_id, sch02_org_id, sch02_start_date, sch02_close_date FROM sch02_share WHERE sch02_info_id = #{infoId}

INSERT INTO sch03_deadline (sch03_deadline_id, sch03_info_id, sch03_company_id, sch03_schedule_cd, sch03_cycle_cd, sch03_cycle_calc_type, sch03_period_cd, sch03_year_cd, sch03_year_type_cd, sch03_month_cd, sch03_month_type_cd, sch03_day_cd, sch03_day_type_cd, sch03_week_cd, sch03_day_week_cd, sch03_holiday_cd, sch03_num1, sch03_num2, sch03_num3, sch03_fix_date, sch03_note, sch03_start_date, sch03_close_date) SELECT f_create_seq(), #{newInfoId}, sch03_company_id, sch03_schedule_cd, sch03_cycle_cd, sch03_cycle_calc_type, sch03_period_cd, sch03_year_cd, sch03_year_type_cd, sch03_month_cd, sch03_month_type_cd, sch03_day_cd, sch03_day_type_cd, sch03_week_cd, sch03_day_week_cd, sch03_holiday_cd, sch03_num1, sch03_num2, sch03_num3, sch03_fix_date, sch03_note, sch03_start_date, sch03_close_date FROM sch03_deadline WHERE sch03_info_id = #{infoId}

INSERT INTO sch05_relate_ics (sch05_relate_ics_id, sch05_info_id, sch05_ics_class_tree_id, sch05_deadline_id) SELECT f_create_seq(), #{newInfoId}, sch05_ics_class_tree_id, sch05_deadline_id FROM sch05_relate_ics WHERE sch05_info_id = #{infoId}

INSERT INTO sch06_alarm (sch06_alarm_id, sch06_company_id, sch06_target_cd, sch06_target_id, sch06_alarm_type, sch06_day_week_cd, sch06_num, sch06_bef_aft_cd, sch06_am_pm_cd, sch06_hour_cd, sch06_minute_cd, sch06_holiday_cd, sch06_use_yn) SELECT f_create_seq(), sch06_company_id, sch06_target_cd, #{newTargetId}, sch06_alarm_type, sch06_day_week_cd, sch06_num, sch06_bef_aft_cd, sch06_am_pm_cd, sch06_hour_cd, sch06_minute_cd, sch06_holiday_cd, sch06_use_yn FROM sch06_alarm WHERE sch06_target_cd = #{targetCode} AND sch06_target_id = #{targetId} AND COALESCE(sch06_use_yn,'false') = 'true'
INSERT INTO sys11_relate_file (sys11_relate_file_id, sys11_file_id, sys11_parent_id, sys11_parent_table) VALUES (#{relateFileId}, #{fileId}, #{parentId}, #{parentTable})
